name: owner_fvg_oside_5

source.title: Owner's idea, 2026-10-19 (second): most recent 5-min FVG on the side of the 09:30 open, middle-candle stop, 1:0.5

entry.words: If we are above the 9:30 open level, we enter on the most recent 5 minute fvg, vice versa for shorts, use the middle candle extreme as the stop and 1:0.5.

taught: [chat 2026-10-19] above the 09:30 open: longs on the most recent FVG
[chat 2026-10-19] below the 09:30 open: shorts on the most recent FVG
[chat 2026-10-19] stop at the middle candle's extreme
not_run: SIDE: price vs the 09:30 open is read on each 5-minute close, not tick by tick. Claude's pick.
THE ENTRY: not said; a limit at the gap's near edge, the usual FVG retest. A newer gap or a flip of the side moves the order. Claude's pick.
WINDOW: not said; entries 09:30-15:00, an unfilled order cancelled at 15:00, flat 15:58. Claude's pick.
TRADES A DAY: not said; one. Claude's pick.
THE STOP: the middle candle's far end; the engine floors any stop at 0.25 ATR and two ticks.
GAP SIZE: any gap of one tick or more (no minimum).
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay).
THE TEST DAYS (2025-07-01 on) ARE NOT READ: this is build days only.
